package.name: f1tenth_messages
package.description: Message and service definitions for the F1TENTH stack: SystemStatus (f1tenth_diagnostics' system_observer_node), RestartComponent/ComponentControl (f1tenth_bringup's component_supervisor_node), LoadMission/MissionStatus (f1tenth_behavior's mission subtree, mission/loader.py -- start_mission/ abort_mission/emergency_stop reuse std_srvs/Trigger, no custom .srv needed), and WallDetection/WallArray (f1tenth_perception's wall_detector_node -- RANSAC plane segmentation for wall/corner detection), and BoundaryConstraint/ BoundaryConstraintArray (hard linear boundary constraints for mpc_controller's OSQP/RTI solver -- published by wall_detector_node's front wall check and the lidar boundary node's left/right line fits). Merged from the former f1tenth_diagnostics_msgs and f1tenth_bringup_msgs -- separate ament_cmake interfaces-only package since both consumer packages are pure ament_python, which can't run rosidl_generate_interfaces() in their own build.
